issues.quote: `/wholesale/` is `noindex` but is in the sitemap and main nav
`/subscriptions/` has the same title tag as `/coffee/`
Shorten: `Bali Kintamani Natural Coffee Beans (250g) | Kopi Kita`.
`/coffee/flores-bajawa/` and `/coffee/sumatra-mandheling/` have no internal links from the site.
Sitemap lists a URL that returns 404: `/coffee/sumatra-mandheling/`
The `Product` has no `name`, a required field.
`FAQPage` schema on `/coffee/` doesn't match the visible page.
Both target "how to make pour over coffee".
The URL, title tag and H1 say "2024" but `dateModified` is 2026-09-01.

wrong_findings.claim: The sitemap lists no `<lastmod>` values, and blog dates are not exposed.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The sitemap does lack `<lastmod>`, but the blog HTML exposes dates in Article JSON-LD, including `dateModified` values such as 2026-09-01.

extra_true.finding: Missing LocalBusiness/CafeOrCoffeeShop structured data and sparse Organization structured data.
Flores Bajawa has no Product schema; Java Ijen's Product name says 250g despite the page also listing 1kg.
Product structured data lacks `sku`, review/rating, `priceValidUntil`, `shippingDetails`, and Offer URLs.
Article structured data lacks image, publisher, mainEntityOfPage, and author URL; the cold brew post has no Article schema.
The best-coffee-beans article's schema headline differs from its H1, and its “our picks this year” copy is undated.
Pages have no Open Graph or Twitter Card tags.
Images lack responsive sources and below-the-fold lazy loading; the hero lacks high fetch priority.
The audit reports missing security headers and caching/compression, a default unbranded 404 page, and a missing favicon.

notes: All 20 planted issues are found. Total counts the 21 numbered findings plus four separate infrastructure findings; repeated entries in the summary and top-fixes table are counted once.
